description: This plot illustrates the relationship between different merging ratios and three performance metrics: Direct Assessment Correlation, Pairwise Ranking Accuracy, and Average Performance. The x-axis is labeled "(Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking) Merging Ratio" and displays ordinal values ranging from 1:9 to 9:1 at regular intervals. The plot features two y-axes. The left y-axis, labeled "Direct Assessment Pearson Correlation," follows a linear scale ranging from 0.500 to 0.675 with tick intervals of 0.025. The right y-axis, labeled "Pairwise Ranking Agreement Accuracy," follows a linear scale ranging from 50 to 75 with tick intervals of 5. Three solid lines are plotted across the graph. The green line, representing Direct Assessment Correlation, features circular markers and corresponds to the left y-axis; it starts at a value of approximately 0.490 at the 1:9 ratio, rises steadily to a peak of approximately 0.670 at the 5:5 ratio, and declines to approximately 0.595 at the 9:1 ratio. The blue line, representing Pairwise Ranking Accuracy, features cross markers and corresponds to the right y-axis; it begins at approximately 77 at the 1:9 ratio, peaks slightly at approximately 78.5 at the 3:7 ratio, and then experiences a sharp decline, ending at approximately 49 at the 9:1 ratio. The black line, representing Average Performance, features square markers and aligns with the numerical scale of the left y-axis; it starts at approximately 0.576 at the 1:9 ratio, increases to a peak of 0.625 at the 5:5 ratio, and decreases to approximately 0.520 at the 9:1 ratio.
